cells.reason: Multiple passages state specific regulatory rules, enforcement actions, and litigation shaping fee structures and pricing transparency for wealth-management firms.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that the SEC's Regulation Best Interest requires broker-dealers to act in the 'best interest' of retail customers at the time a recommendation is made without placing the financial or other interests of the broker-dealer ahead of the interest of the retail customer.
items.quote: the SEC's "Regulation Best Interest," which requires broker-dealers to act in the "best interest" of retail customers at the time a recommendation is made without placing the financial or other interests of the broker-dealer ahead of the interest of the retail customer.

items.text: Raymond James states that under the Dodd-Frank Act the SEC adopted Regulation Best Interest, which requires a broker-dealer to act in the best interest of a retail client when making a recommendation, and Form CRS, which requires retail investors be given a brief summary document with information about the relationship, and that various states have proposed or adopted laws imposing new standards of conduct on broker-dealers.
items.quote: Regulation Best Interest requires a broker-dealer to act in the best interest of a retail client when making a recommendation to that client of any securities transaction or investment strategy involving securities. Form CRS requires that broker-dealers and investment advisers provide retail investors with a brief summary document containing simple, easy-to-understand information about the nature of the relationship between the parties.

items.text: Edward Jones states it is subject to the SEC rule requiring registered investment advisers and broker-dealers to deliver a Form CRS Relationship Summary informing clients of the types of relationships offered, the applicable standards of care, and information on fees, costs, conflicts of interest, and legal and disciplinary history.
items.quote: Edward Jones is also subject to the SEC rule requiring registered investment advisers and broker-dealers to deliver a Form CRS Relationship Summary to their clients informing them of the types of client relationships offered, together with the applicable standards of care, and information on fees, costs, conflicts of interest, and legal and disciplinary history.

items.text: Raymond James states that in April 2024 the Department of Labor issued a final rule significantly expanding the definition of 'investment advice fiduciary' under ERISA and finalized amendments to several class prohibited transaction exemptions that exempt certain compensation arrangements otherwise prohibited, and that if the rules become effective compliance will require altering certain business practices and imposing additional costs.
items.quote: In April 2024, the Department of Labor ("DOL") issued a final rule significantly expanding the definition of "investment advice fiduciary" under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974... the DOL also finalized amendments to several class prohibited transaction exemptions ("PTE"), which exempt certain compensation arrangements that would otherwise be prohibited... we expect compliance will require us to alter certain of our business practices and impose additional costs.

items.text: Schwab states that in March 2026 federal district courts reached final resolutions on pending litigation and formally vacated the U.S. Department of Labor's April 2024 final rule to broaden the definition of 'fiduciary' under ERISA, and the rule was removed from the Code of Federal Regulations.
items.quote: In March 2026, federal district courts reached final resolutions on pending litigation and formally vacated the U.S. Department of Labor's April 2024 final rule to broaden the definition of "fiduciary" under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974. Following the courts' ruling, the U.S. Department of Labor's Employee Benefits Security Administration removed the rule from the Code of Federal Regulations.

items.text: Raymond James states that the FCA's Consumer Duty, effective in the UK on July 31, 2023, requires firms to act to deliver 'good outcomes' for retail customers with respect to products and services, price and value, consumer understanding, and consumer support.
items.quote: on July 31, 2023, the FCA's Consumer Duty took effect in the UK. Among other things, the UK Consumer Duty requires firms to act to deliver "good outcomes" for retail customers with respect to products and services, price and value, consumer understanding, and consumer support.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that under Department of Labor regulations under Section 408(b)(2) of ERISA, MSWM is required to provide certain information regarding its services and compensation to assist fiduciaries and plan sponsors in assessing the reasonableness of their plan's contracts or arrangements, including the reasonableness of its compensation.
items.quote: In accordance with Department of Labor regulations under Section 408(b)(2) of ERISA, MSWM is required to provide certain information regarding our services and compensation to assist fiduciaries and plan sponsors... in assessing the reasonableness of their plan's contracts or arrangements with us, including the reasonableness of our compensation.

items.text: Merrill Lynch states that under Department of Labor regulations under Section 408(b)(2) of ERISA it is required to provide certain information regarding its services and compensation to assist fiduciaries and plan sponsors of retirement accounts subject to ERISA in assessing the reasonableness of compensation.
items.quote: In accordance with Department of Labor regulations under Section 408(b)(2) of ERISA, we are required to provide certain information regarding our services and compensation to assist fiduciaries and plan sponsors... in assessing the reasonableness of their plan's contracts or arrangements with us, including the reasonableness of our compensation.

items.text: Raymond James states that beginning in August 2024 the SEC's Division of Enforcement requested information regarding its practices related to cash sweep programs for investment advisory clients, and that class action lawsuits were filed alleging breach of fiduciary duties with regard to rates paid to clients in its cash sweep programs.
items.quote: beginning in August 2024, the SEC's Division of Enforcement requested information regarding our practices related to cash sweep programs for investment advisory clients and has reportedly conducted similar reviews at other financial institutions... alleging, among other things, that the firm breached its fiduciary duties or agreements with regard to rates paid to clients in our cash sweep programs.

items.text: Trade press reports that the SEC has been focused on cash sweep account options for several years, with sizable settlements including a $187 million agreement with Charles Schwab in 2022 over misleading disclosures related to its robo-advisor cash program, and that the SEC closed its probe into LPL's cash sweep program without enforcement action in January 2026.
items.quote: The SEC has been focused on cash sweep account options for several years, with sizable settlements that included a $187 million agreement with Charles Schwab in 2022 over misleading disclosures related to its robo-advisor cash program.
items.scope: Charles Schwab robo-advisor cash program settlement

items.text: Merrill Lynch states that on April 3, 2023 the SEC issued an administrative order finding MLPF&S violated the Advisers Act because wrap fee advisory program agreements and ADV brochures contained a material misstatement by failing to disclose an additional 'production credit' fee on foreign currency exchanges, resulting in a penalty totaling $9,694,714.
items.quote: wrap fee advisory program agreements and ADV brochures contained a material misstatement because, while disclosing that MLPF&S charged a mark-up or markdown on foreign currency exchanges, the disclosure did not also state that an additional fee referred to as a production credit was also charged... payment of disgorgement, prejudgment interest and a civil penalty totaling $9,694,714.

items.text: Schwab states the SEC found that CS&Co. made false and misleading statements in Form ADV Part 2A brochures about the cash allocations in Schwab Intelligent Portfolios accounts, including about its conflict of interest in setting the cash allocations and the negative effect of the cash allocations on performance.
items.quote: The SEC found that CS&Co. made false and misleading statements in Form ADV Part 2A brochures about the cash allocations in Schwab Intelligent Portfolios accounts, in particular about: CS&Co.'s conflict of interest in setting the cash allocations; the influence of this conflict of interest on the size of the cash allocations; and the negative effect of the cash allocations on performance...

items.text: Trade press reports the SEC has targeted advisors and firms in ongoing 'sweeps' over misleading advertising, with wealth management firms cited for failing to comply with Rule 206(4)-1 (the Marketing Rule) governing how third-party ratings are used, including a September 2024 sweep settling against nine RIAs for a combined $1.24 million in fines.
items.quote: the SEC has targeted advisors and firms in ongoing "sweeps" to ferret out misleading advertising. Wealth management firms have been cited for failing to comply with the rules governing how third-party ratings are used under Rule 206(4)-1 (The Marketing Rule)... In a Sept. 2024 sweep, the SEC investigated and settled cases against nine registered investment advisers (RIAs) for a combined $1.24 million in fines.

items.text: FINRA's oversight materials reference SEC Rule 606 of Regulation NMS disclosures on order handling and routing, including responses to frequently asked questions and a risk alert on observations related to Rule 606 disclosures.
items.quote: Responses to Frequently Asked Questions Concerning Rule 606 of Regulation NMS (updated June 26, 2024)... Division of Examinations Risk Alert: Observations Related to Regulation NMS Rule 606 Disclosures (Nov. 10, 2022)... SEC Adopts Rules That Increase Information Brokers Must Provide to Investors on Order Handling (Nov. 2, 2018)

items.text: Schwab states that on June 12, 2025 the SEC withdrew certain notices of proposed rulemaking, including the December 2022 equity market structure rule proposals 'Order Competition Rule' and 'Regulation Best Execution', which the company had been evaluating.
items.quote: On June 12, 2025, the SEC withdrew certain notices of proposed rulemaking issued between March 2022 and November 2023... The withdrawn proposals included the December 2022 equity market structure rule proposals, "Order Competition Rule" and "Regulation Best Execution".
